tool_args.rationale: The data have nearly constant y/u_now across varied inputs and horizons near the requested forecast horizon, consistent with an uncoupled Kelvin–Voigt creep response. Fit its two physical parameters numerically and use the supplied confirmation stage to test the forecast.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five observations span the target horizon and show a stable near-linear response; the two-parameter creep law can be fit without another paid measurement.
The observed near-proportionality to u_now does not establish the additional state-dependent parameters, and five rows would not identify a four-parameter coupled law reliably.
It predicts a nonlinear dependence on u_now that is not supported by the nearly constant y/u_now ratios.
It is not relevant to identifying this smooth target law and has no demonstrated information value.
